text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — noticed p99 spike on dashboard for /v2/generate in eu-west around 21:30. p50/p95 stable, sample_count for that slice dropped ~3x. Suspect routing fallback. Anyone seen it?
Samir: Yup saw it. Weight flip to compat-lowmem route. Tail worsens when that route gets more traffic.
Janelle: Which dashboard query? Need to confirm if console is showing tdigest rollups or raw samples.
Priya: Console uses this simplified query:
```
SELECT tdigest_percentile(rollup_tdigest, 0.99) as p99, sum(sample_count) as samples
FROM endpoint_latency_rollups
WHERE endpoint = '/v2/generate' AND region = 'eu-west' AND window = '5m'
GROUP BY time_bucket
```
Samir: That's tdigest-based. When samples drop tdigest can misestimate extremes depending on compression and sample origin.
Alex: compat-lowmem pool has telemetry downsampling to reduce ingest cost. That downsampled stream feeds rollups for that pool.
Priya: Timing matches — quota fallback kicked for a subset of tenants at ~21:25. So downsampling + route change likely caused the p99 artifact.
Janelle: Two approaches: 1) compute p99 from raw samples for low-sample windows (accurate but costly), or 2) surface sample provenance & confidence in UI and mark p99 as low-confidence when sample_count < threshold.
Samir: Start with provenance + heuristic. Show sample_source and a 'low confidence' pill when samples < 200, with an action 'compute raw p99' that runs an on-demand job.
Alex: Also we have a naming mismatch: some telemetry producers use tag routing_policy, others use route_variant. UI grouping breaks. We should standardize schema before rolling out provenance UI.
Priya: I'll run a small canary: flip telemetry.downsample=false for compat-lowmem at 10% and compare p99 for 30m. If p99 returns to baseline it's a sampling artifact. Canary script:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://internal-config.redwood/v1/routes/compat-lowmem/config \
  -d '{ "telemetry": { "downsample": false }, "canary_pct": 10 }'
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout requested by Priya - config toggle telemetry.downsample=false for route compat-lowmem (canary 10%).
Alex: If confirmed, we'll add provenance + docs note about how downsampling affects tdigest p99. Long-term idea: cheap fallback estimator that flags p99 alerts when rollup sample origin != raw.
Janelle: I'll draft a UI: provenance pill next to percentile labels, tooltip explaining sample_source + sample_count, and a 'run raw p99' button to trigger on-demand job. Posting mock tomorrow.
Samir: Also add an internal metrics API endpoint to expose sample_origin per-rollup timeslice; UI can fetch and compute confidence client-side.
Priya: Running canary now, will share before/after charts in ~15m and list tenant ids used in canary.
Samir: :thumbsup:
Alex: Consider gating the config toggle by tenant tier — leave low-priority tenants downsampled but flag them in dashboard.
Priya: Good call, will include tenant filter in canary.
Janelle: Ping me with results and I'll wire UX into dashboard code.
Priya: Will do.
